authority: This is design/research metadata, not a runtime schema, art approval or phase acceptance. Supplied source-game attribution is retained; exact mechanics and timing are not established by still images.
evidenceLimits: Black concealed regions, especially 0–2% reveal frames, do not establish absent artwork.
Full-frame inspection establishes visible layout and silhouettes, not native gameplay-size sprite quality, animation timing, AI, collision ownership, shooting or capture algorithms.
The three AVIF originals were converted locally by sips to PNG only for viewing after view_image rejected AVIF. Source hashes below always identify originals.
Numbered references retain their supplied pack/level order. Working titles and adaptations are proposals, not existing content identities.
Original artwork and authored geometry must be produced and reviewed. Reference images stay research material and are not included as runtime assets.
These 48 proposals occupy the four already planned FPV campaigns. UI and extra gameplay specimens add no missions. The remaining 84 missions and both Team variants remain separately planned.
Reuse of an approved body requires approval for any new semantic role; matching colour or a still screenshot does not prove cross-mode parity.

acceptanceDefinitions.map-authoring: Author actual orthogonal geometry in the current supported schema, validate reachability, terrain meaning, starting safety and readable alternate approaches; decoration cannot imply collision.
acceptanceDefinitions.map-art: Create original approved composition and validated derivatives, exact content/edition/revision binding, preview/reveal/results/Retry parity and preserved pinned originals. Determine compatible modes explicitly; Team variants remain separate existing arenas.
acceptanceDefinitions.map-play: Play-review the authored mission at Gentle/Standard/Hard with encounters on/off where supported. Check the stated learning goal and alternatives; qualify replay/checkpoint determinism and the relevant native input/layout journeys. A design row is not a completed mission.
acceptanceDefinitions.map-encounters: Use only approved deterministic roles and limits after P09. No new attacks or homing; no shooters in the first three positions and at most two shooter missions per campaign. Encounters-off remains a complete challenge.
acceptanceDefinitions.map-release: Finish the twelve-mission campaign with exact-source gates, production readiness, compatible-mode inventory, immutable release and public/offline evidence. Record the actual IDs, version and receipts after adoption.
acceptanceDefinitions.ui-navigation: Qualify actual keyboard-only, touch-only and supported controller-only journeys, current binding prompts, focus return, >=44 CSS-pixel controls, responsive layouts and interrupted intent. Keep modeled, native, visual and physical evidence separate.
acceptanceDefinitions.ui-feedback: Use original registered components/effects; inspect relevant normal/loading/error/disabled/pause/return states, light/dark art, muted sound and reduced effects. Preserve simulation timing and explicit input ownership.
acceptanceDefinitions.ui-release: Qualify the final integrated source and relevant public/offline journeys before phase acceptance; existing candidate receipts do not qualify new composition.
